text: だれもが　みんな　しってる　シルフ　カンパニー　だが　ゆうめい　だと　それだけ　ねらわれる　きけんも　あるのだ

structure.jp: だれもが　みんな　しってる　シルフ　カンパニー
structure.en: Silph Co., which absolutely everyone knows

structure.jp: それだけ　ねらわれる　きけんも
structure.en: that much danger of being targeted too

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending turns a verb around so the action is done to you. ねらわれる = 'be targeted'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after だ means 'if or whenever this is so, that follows'. ゆうめい　だと = 'when you are famous'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: だれもが　みんな　しってる　シルフ　カンパニー
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing tells you which thing it is; しってる is the shortened spoken しっている. だれもが　みんな　しってる　シルフ　カンパニー = 'Silph Co., which everyone knows'.
